items.headline: Deion Sanders laments Colorado struggles, says he's not worried about job
items.description: Asked after a loss to Arizona State if he felt like his job was on the line, Colorado coach Deion Sanders told reporters: "I don't think about that, man. I'm not here for my job. I'm here for these young men."
